en: I gonna make you into mojo!
It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

Teach you gnomish engineering? I don't have time for this nonsense. You only get one chance with Oglethorpe and you blew that, didn't you?$B$BYou'll have to head to Tanaris and find Narain Soothfancy's hut. In that hut is a magical book that might be able to jostle whatever is left of your brain and reconnect you with what you've lost.$B$BNow get lost!
You can find passage to Theramore from this dock.  Heed my words, those lands are rarely safe to travel for people of the Alliance.  Watch your step and your back.
Heya, $c! Lookin' like we got all the spotted yellowtail that we be needin' for that war. Maybe you going to some of the other collectors 'round here and askin' them if they be needin' your help?
Korrak has come, weaklings! Snowfall belongs to Winterax!
A successful test!  $n, this indurium is some amazing stuff.
Take care of yourself, Antonio. I'll see you in another week.
Now you've gone and done it. I thought you were better than the people at Southshore. They would have bought all my wares!
Hey Reese, give me an' Christoph another round.
Thank you for your help, $n. I wish you well in your adventures.
Kazum!  I hold your scepter!  I command you to enter this world!
Give my regards to Commander Trebor, $r.
The battle for Warsong Gulch is a battle that we cannot lose.  We fight for our honor and we fight for our land, and no orc or misguided ally will take them from us!
Dat's da attitude! Grab a needle and thread and let's get jammin'!
%s appears lost in contemplation.
We feel nothing. Our souls remain here, in limbo. We are unable to leave until our remains are found and spirits laid to rest.
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
I'm afraid you're out of my league, friend! You should go see Nogg in Orgrimmar, he'll take you to the next level!

Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?
I will return when I have the Plates of Uldum.
What are the Plates of Uldum?
Dabu! I will be careful Papa!
He will stop at nothing to get to Malfurion's physical manifestation. That must not happen... We must keep the beast occupied long enough for Tyrande to arrive.

We will locate the origin of the Nightmare through the fragments you collected, $n. From there we will pull Eranikus through a rift in the Dream. Steel yourself, $c. We are inviting the embodiment of the Nightmare into our world.
Take heart!$B$BThe Soulflayer has been defeated and his wretched heart has been cast into the nether!
One of these days I'm gonna drown him in that blue robe. And all his brooms too.
This is a dangerous place, $n. Be careful around here.
Measuring by Kraklenheit, it is 428,000 degrees! That's Krakley!

<Cyrus's eyes glow brightly>$B$BDo I devour you whole or do I allow you to live?$B$BPerhaps you could still be of some use...$B$BChallenge my minion, $r. Survive and return proof of your victory to me.
As good as I told you it would be, yes?
Thank you.
Still alive? You do surprise. Watch me as I flee!
What happens when I do this?!
Hello, $n! I am master engineer, Scooty.
At last! Free from Northwatch Hold! I need a moment to catch my breath....
Kneel before me, mortal! Kneel before Zod!
The Stormpike Aid Station was taken by the Horde!
I'll begin drawing energy from the stone.  Your job, $n, is to defend me. This place is cursed...trust me.
